text:
ana: Heads-up — finished the Kite customer LoRA merge into our 7B openbase, ran the quickpack, and we see a perplexity jump focused on tokenization boundary cases. attaching short logs below.

evan: saw the spike. my first guess is a tokenizer mismatch between the adapter's training tokenizer and the base model vocab. did kite use sentencepiece?

ana: (typo) meant to say @ana — yeah kite adapters were trained on spm, our base is byte-level BPE. merge script didn't remap token ids, so some common tokens split differently.

jasper: @ana can you paste the tokenizer config diff and which quantization profile you used? also did you run int4 q8_0 or int8?

ana: used int4 q4_0 fused for perf. tokenizer diff (excerpt):

```
- tokenizer: {type: "byte_bpe", vocabulary_size: 50257}
+ tokenizer: {type: "sentencepiece", model_file: "kite_spm.model", vocab_size: 32000}
```

maria: that explains it. token id remap is required when adapter relies on spm boundaries. quick experiment: I ran a token-map remapping script + reindexed adapter weights -> small smoke eval: ppls (50 prompts): baseline=11.2, merged=15.8, remapped_patch=12.6. improvement but not perfect.

eval-bot: quick-eval pack complete — 50 prompts, metrics: exact_match_top1: baseline=0.82 -> merged=0.69 -> remapped_patch=0.78; semantic-sim (emb cosine avg): baseline=0.91 -> merged=0.87 -> remapped_patch=0.90. Link: https://ci.internal/evals/2101234567

ana: thanks @maria and @eval-bot. plan: produce a small customer smokepack that includes (1) token-id remap step, (2) fallback float decoding for segments that map to OOV ranges, (3) embedding-regression checks. will canary on dedicated for deterministic workloads.

evan: also add kv-cache alignment test. saw a sticky bug where prefix caching misaligns when remapped token ids change sequence length heuristics. quick snippet to reproduce: 

```
# repro
input = "A long prompt..."
ids = remap_tokens(tokenizer.encode(input))
# run 1: generate with cache
# run 2: generate with truncated prefix -> mismatch in keys
```

jasper: ok branch created: refs/heads/ana/kite-tokenmap. @maria please review. noted customer asks for deterministic sampling for eval — set temperature=0 and top_k=1 for quickpack. :thumbsup:

maria: reviewing now. also flag: embedding drift ~3% on their search benchmarks after naive merge. include semantic-recall tests in quickpack.

ana: accepted. I'll add the embedding tests + a small notebook showing remap procedure for the solutions engineer. ETA EOD today. ping if you want me to hold canary until after infra autoscale test. :coffee:
